# controld_endpoint_schedule (Resource)

Manages an endpoint schedule: a weekly set of time windows attached to a device, during which another profile is enforced on that device. This relies on an undocumented ControlD API endpoint (`/endpointschedules`), so its behaviour may change without notice.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "controld_endpoint_schedule" "bedtime" {
  name      = "Kids bedtime"
  device_id = controld_device.kids_tablet.id
  time_zone = "Europe/Paris"

  # Enforce the strict profile on weekday evenings.
  windows = [
    for day in ["mon", "tue", "wed", "thu", "fri"] : {
      weekday    = day
      time_start = "21:00"
      time_end   = "23:59"
      profile_id = controld_profile.strict.id
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (String) The identifier of the device the schedule is attached to. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
- `name` (String) The name of the schedule.
- `time_zone` (String) The IANA time zone the windows are expressed in, e.g. `Europe/Paris`.
- `windows` (Attributes List) The time windows of the schedule. Windows on the same day cannot overlap. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--windows))

### Optional

- `status` (Boolean) Whether the schedule is enabled. Defaults to enabled.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The schedule identifier (PK).

<a id="nestedatt--windows"></a>
### Nested Schema for `windows`

Required:

- `profile_id` (String) The identifier of the profile enforced on the device during the window.
- `time_end` (String) When the window ends, in 24h `HH:MM` format.
- `time_start` (String) When the window starts, in 24h `HH:MM` format.
- `weekday` (String) The day of the week the window applies to. One of: `mon`, `tue`, `wed`, `thu`, `fri`, `sat`, `sun`.
